name: rnaseq.deg
description: Perform two-group differential expression analysis of bulk RNA-seq raw counts using DESeq2.
use_when: Raw gene counts with a defined treatment-versus-control question and at least two independent biological replicates per group.
do_not_use_when: TPM/FPKM, normalized expression, single-cell counts, or an existing DEG table needing only plotting.
More than two groups in metadata, paired/batch-adjusted/complex designs, or treatment equal to control.

metadata_path.description: UTF-8 CSV requiring sample_id and condition; exactly the requested two groups.

deg_csv.description: deg_results.csv: full non-all-zero-gene DESeq2 results, including legitimate NA statistics; gene_id, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj.

filtered_csv.description: deg_filtered.csv: genes passing padj < alpha and abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_threshold; may contain header only.

requirements.filesystem: Readable local inputs and a new/empty writable output_dir; no network annotation lookup.

downstream.notes: Full results, not the filtered table, preserve NS counts.
Also requires matching metadata and VST expression or raw counts.
Requires non-empty query, matching user GO mapping and separate eligible background.
Background only; excludes NA padj/log2FC. Never treat all full-table genes as selected DEGs.
Requires non-empty query, pathway mapping and eligible background.

limitations: Fixed ~condition design; treatment vs control explicitly oriented; no batch correction or complex formula.
DESeq2 raw-count semantics and biological independence cannot be proven from numeric CSV values.
R may fail on insufficiently informative data; validation is not a guarantee of estimability.
No DEGs is a valid succeeded result; downstream empty-query enrichment is not automatically run.
